title: GB10 · vLLM
source: Verbatim lines from the GB10 run logs in ~/gb10_benchmark (smoke.log, np1.log, np5.log, np5_out64.log, np5_out512.log, np5_64k_out64.log); home paths shortened to ~/, and the list of other services' containers replaced by one line.

runner.command:
cd ~/gb10_benchmark && . ./env.sh
python3 -u GB10_vllm_gemma26_5user_longctx.py smoke > smoke.log 2>&1
export GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.70
python3 -u GB10_vllm_gemma26_5user_longctx.py run --users 1 --contexts 131072,262144 --output 1024 > np1.log 2>&1
python3 -u GB10_vllm_gemma26_5user_longctx.py run --users 5 --contexts 32768,65536 --output 1024 > np5.log 2>&1
python3 -u GB10_vllm_gemma26_5user_longctx.py run --users 5 --contexts 32768,65536 --output 64 > np5_out64.log 2>&1
python3 -u GB10_vllm_gemma26_5user_longctx.py run --users 5 --contexts 32768,65536 --output 512 > np5_out512.log 2>&1
python3 -u GB10_vllm_gemma26_5user_longctx.py run --users 5 --contexts 65536 --output 64 --send-anyway > np5_64k_out64.log 2>&1
runner.note: Each run starts its own vLLM container (sb-gb10-vllm) and removes it at the end. Results: ~/gb10_benchmark/results/<run>/ (summary.csv, case_*.json).
